brief:
Four Palestinians were wounded by shrapnel from a bomb dropped by an Israeli drone in the al-Mahatta neighborhood north of Khan Yunis in southern Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The strike hit the residential area today, leaving all four casualties injured by fragmentation from the explosive.

The incident marks the latest in a series of Israeli military operations that have continued across Gaza. The drone attack underscores the ongoing pattern of aerial strikes affecting civilian areas in the territory.
